events.title: 밀월's six–week hunt for a new manager ends when they appoint 브루스 리옥.
리버풀 return to the top of the First Division with a 2–1 win over 윔블던 at Anfield.

리버풀's hopes of a unique second double are ended when they lose 4–3 after extra time to 크리스털 팰리스 in the semi–finals of the FA Cup at Villa Park . 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 3–3 with 올덤 애슬레틱 in the other semi–final at Maine Road .

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 올덤 애슬레틱 2–1 after extra time in the FA Cup semi–final replay. The game is however marred by controversy after referee 조 워럴 fails to award Oldham an early goal after Nick Henry 's shot clearly crosses the line. In the league, 리버풀 move closer to their 18th league title with a 4–0 away win over struggling 찰턴 애슬레틱, in which on–loan striker Ronny Rosenthal scores a hat–trick. 애스턴 빌라 keep up their challenge by winning 1–0 away to 아스널.

밀월 are relegated to the Second Division after losing 2–0 at 더비 카운티. Charlton's 3–2 defeat at 사우샘프턴 leaves them needing to win their four remaining games to stand any chance of avoiding relegation. 리버풀 remain top of the table but drop two points when they are held to a 2–2 draw by 노팅엄 포리스트 at Anfield.

Luton are left needing at least six points from their final three games to avoid relegation after losing 3–0 at 노팅엄 포리스트. 맨체스터 시티's survival is confirmed with a 1–0 win at 노리치 시티. There is major drama in the Second Division promotion race, when leaders Leeds beat 셰필드 유나이티드 4–0 at Elland Road, sending the visitors into third place, as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 move into second place with a 3–0 home win over Stoke, which sends the visitors down to the Third Division.

20–year–old striker Mark Robins scores twice in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–0 home league win over 애스턴 빌라 – a result which puts the opposition's title hopes into serious doubt. 찰턴 애슬레틱 lose 2–1 at home to 윔블던 and are relegated.

리버풀 take another step towards the title with a 4–1 home win over 첼시. 애스턴 빌라 keep their hopes alive with a 1–0 home win over 밀월. Luton keep their survival bid alive with a 2–0 home win over 아스널, while 셰필드 웬즈데이 are still in danger of going down with a 1–0 defeat to QPR at Loftus Road .

리버풀 seal their 18th top division title with a 2–1 home win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스 as 애스턴 빌라 draw 3–3 at home to 노리치 시티. The battle to avoid the last relegation place in the First Division will go right to the wire, with Luton and 셰필드 웬즈데이 both winning their penultimate First Division games. The Second Division promotion race will also go right down to the wire. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's 2–1 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 keeps them in the hunt for automatic promotion, while leaving the visiting side's playoff hopes hanging by a thread. Leeds remain top of the table but second placed 셰필드 유나이티드 will go up and move into pole position if they win their game in hand. 체스터 시티 play the final Football League game at their Sealand Road home of 84 years – a 2–0 win over 로더럼 유나이티드 .

노팅엄 포리스트 retain the League Cup with a 1–0 win over 올덤 애슬레틱 in the final . Nigel Jemson scores the only goal of the game. 콜체스터 유나이티드 are relegated to the GM Vauxhall Conference after 40 years in the Football League , their demotion from the Fourth Division being confirmed by a 4–0 defeat to 케임브리지 유나이티드 at the Abbey Stadium , a result which keeps the home side's playoff hopes alive.

The month ends with 리버풀 confirmed as First Division champions, and 애스턴 빌라 sure of second place. 루턴 타운 trail 셰필드 웬즈데이 by three points with one game remaining in the fight to avoid the last relegation place. The Second Division promotion race is still wide open. 리즈 유나이티드 (top), 셰필드 유나이티드 (second) and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 (third) are fighting it out for automatic promotion. 스윈던 타운, 블랙번 로버스 and 선덜랜드 complete the top six, but 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 입스위치 타운 and 올덤 애슬레틱 still have a mathematical chance of breaking into the playoffs.
